## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change against `main`
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `npm run lint:readme` pass
- [ ] Tests for the change pass; a behaviour change adds one
- [ ] The README Features line changed if what a user can do changed
- [ ] New dependencies have exact versions and a `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` entry
- [ ] No secrets, environment files, real addresses, logs or user data
